title: ONS 2015: Wednesday Keynote - Amin Vahdat
summary: Google's Amin Vahdat gives the ONS 2015 keynote on Google's datacenter networking, including its custom hardware, software-defined networking and very high bisection bandwidth.
why: HN cites it as a rare public look at Google's internal network design and how it scales to many VMs.

quote.text: If you're interested in datacenter networking, can't miss ONS.
